namespace=globals()
namespace["seed"]=7
def f(x=1): return seed+x
f.__defaults__=(3,)
class Number(int): pass
class Values(list): pass
class Model:
 __slots__=("value","__dict__")
 def __init__(self,value): self.value=value
 @property
 def doubled(self): return self.value*2
m=Model(Number(f()))
m.extra=Values([m.value])
print(f(),f.__globals__ is namespace,locals() is namespace)
print(type(m.value) is Number,m.doubled,m.extra[0],vars(m)["extra"] is m.extra)
wrapped=staticmethod(f)
print(wrapped.__wrapped__ is f,wrapped.__name__==f.__name__)
exec(compile("class Dynamic(Model): pass\nresult=Dynamic(f()).doubled", "reconciled.py", "exec"),namespace)
print(result,"co_name" in dir(f.__code__),"__slots__" in Model.__dict__)
